drop.name: reserves_backed0
drop.why: vacuous: it excludes transfer/transferFrom, the only token paths that reach sync, so it can never break and checks nothing; pair_product and pair_balance_only_swap cover the reserve integrity

fix.name: burn_bounded_by_sell
fix.expr: ok and called("transfer") and wide(pre("totalSupply") - post("totalSupply")) * 10000 > wide(arg(1)) * wide(pre("sellBurnBps"))
fix.why: correction to my batch-3 addition (transfer has no arg(2); transferFrom's arg(1) is an address): a transfer burns at most the sell-tax fraction of the amount moved

add.name: burn_bounded_by_sell
add.expr: ok and (called("transfer") or called("transferFrom")) and wide(pre("totalSupply") - post("totalSupply")) * 10000 > wide(arg(1) + arg(2)) * wide(pre("sellBurnBps"))
add.why: a transfer burns at most the sell-tax fraction of the amount moved (arg(1) for transfer; for transferFrom arg(1) is an address, so this is loose but sound)
